title: Suspiro a la Limeña
description: Suspiro a la Limeña is a dish from Peru featuring sweetened condensed milk, evaporated milk, chicken egg, pasteurized egg whites. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used. Pasteurized egg whites are used in the meringue; refrigerate the finished dessert.

steps.instruction: Simmer the liquid and flavorings uncovered for about 18 minutes until reduced and concentrated.
Prepare a fully cooked Swiss meringue using pasteurized whites and sugar over gentle steam, whisking until glossy and stable.
Layer the previously prepared components evenly inside a baking dish, serving mold or plate appropriate to the recipe; smooth the surface and avoid mixing the layers.
Refrigerate the prepared mixture for about 80 minutes, cooling perishable foods promptly and never holding cooked rice warm at room temperature.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
